Also, if we (or our assets) are acquired, merged, reorganized, or if we cease operations, enter bankruptcy, or go through some other change of control or similar event, you acknowledge that Personal Information could be one of the assets transferred to or acquired by a third party.We employ other companies and individuals to perform tasks on our behalf and need to share your information with them to provide products or services to you. 2\.4. The User can also at any time choose to stop receiving any form of commercial communications about the Service from Talowiz, they may request so by sending an email to [support@talowiz.com](mailto:support@talowiz.com) .

7\.1. **Google Analytics** : Utilization of Google Analytics is employed for the purpose of tracking our website traffic. Google Analytics serves as a web analytics service provided by Google itself.
